title: Induced dynamics and quasifactors for minimal equicontinuous actions on Stone spaces
summary: A minimal equicontinuous action of a group $G$ on a Stone space $X$ is called a subodometer. If such a subodometer arises from a group rotation, we refer to it as an odometer. For subodometers $(X,G)$ we show that the hyperspace $\mathcal{H}(X)$ - given by all closed subsets of $X$ and the Vietoris topology - decomposes into subodometers. We show that an infinite subodometer is an odometer if and only if $\mathcal{H}(X)$ decomposes into factors of $(X,G)$.
